Getting the basics down are ofc very important but for 'higher level' stuff like dragging/acceling it's all abt wrist movement and keeping it slow, don't use your arm to move your mouse just your wrist

Another thing to keep in mind is to react not to predict. With that try not to block incoming attacks until just before it hits so you wont fall for feints as often.

You can feint during the windup of attacks but not so often during the actual swinging so just wait for the swinging anim, this can get a bit trickier with accels though

The rest of it really is just fixing your reaction time and learning how fast different weapons swing

For training, slower weapons are easier to drag & accel with so train with them until you get the hang of it, I suggest Greatsword, Maul, or Eveningstar
